# Feature `image:stateless-rootfs`

Image feature `stateless-rootfs`:

specifies that the image should be created as stateless - when using `systemd`, `systemctl-native` will not be run on the image, leaving the image for population at runtime by systemd.

Source: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/features.html#image-features
